How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Alliance Air Aviation Paramedics Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.allianceair.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by Alliance Air Aviation for filling up healthcare positions in Hyderabad on a contract basis under advertisement number AAAL/PERS/2026/864.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The post available in this recruitment notification is Paramedics, aimed at hiring qualified healthcare professionals for various medical and clinical support duties.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for Alliance Air Paramedics Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Paramedics post under this recruitment notification issued by Alliance Air Aviation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled-in offline applications along with required documents is 10-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely dispatch to avoid rejection.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for Alliance Air Aviation Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Interested candidates must download the application format from the website, fill it out, and send it by post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Paramedics post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years as on 25.09.2026. Candidates must verify their age criteria against the official guidelines before applying.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must be registered under the Nursing Council of India/State Nursing Council, or be Allied Health and healthcare professionals as per NCAHP Act 2021, or be registered under the Pharmacy Council of India/State Pharmacy Council.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Paramedics post will receive a gross salary of approximately INR 30,000/- per month on a Fixed Term Employment Agreement basis.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General, OBC, and EWS candidates is Rs. 1500/-, whereas SC and ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed offline application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application along with the CV and Demand Draft must be sent by post, speed post, or courier to Alliance Air, Personnel Department, Alliance Bhawan, Domestic Terminal -1, I.G.I Airport, New Delhi – 110037.
